title: One TRICARE Premium-Based Plan per Purchaser
content:
**Enrollment operations manual - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, holding limits.**

1. A purchaser may hold at most one premium-based plan at a time - a limit of 1 per purchaser.
2. Member-only and member-and-family are two tiers of one plan, not two purchases; moving between them is a coverage-type change on the same plan.
3. A premium-based plan cannot be held together with TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select by the same beneficiary. Buying a premium-based plan while holding one of them is a plan change that ends the other enrollment on the day before the premium-based plan's effective date.
4. A purchase is accepted under this limit only where the purchaser has no applied or active premium-based plan on the application date. This is read from the purchaser's own premium-plan records in the system, matched to the purchaser of the new application.

## Clause 4 by the status of an existing plan of the same purchaser on the application date

| Existing premium-based plan of the purchaser | Clause 4 met? |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| applied | no |
| active | no |
| rejected, or terminated (by request, for nonpayment, or for ineligibility) | yes - the plan is neither applied nor active |

## Worked situations (hypothetical)

- A TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only purchaser marries and wants family coverage: this is a coverage-type change on the same plan (clause 2), not a second purchase.
- A beneficiary enrolled in TRICARE Select buys TRICARE Young Adult Select with an effective date of 1 January: the TRICARE Select enrollment ends on 31 December, the day before (clause 3).
